args.fix: Replaced check-then-act SELECT+UPDATE with a single atomic conditional UPDATE (WHERE balance >= amount); success iff rowcount==1, otherwise re-check existence to raise ValueError (unknown account) or InsufficientFunds. Row-level lock is held only on the target account, so unrelated accounts stay concurrent.
args.root_cause: withdraw() ran SELECT balance then UPDATE balance in separate statements under READ COMMITTED with no row lock: two concurrent withdrawals on the same account both read the same pre-deduction balance, both passed the `balance < amount` check, and both deducted, driving the balance negative (lost-update / check-then-act race).
